You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"Before the May 2023 audit, rollup-service was effectively unowned in practice: people each had part of the map, but nobody had the complete downstream ownership picture. The Apr 18 outage exposed that gap. The lesson was to name a single accountable owner and make the downstream boundary explicit; the audit assigned rollup-service to Cyrus\u2019s team. Keep this distinct from metric-rollup, the separate deprecated service."

CONTEXT: {"user_request": "Comment on doc-rollup-ownership-retro with the rollup-service ownership lesson from before the May 2023 audit.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_doc_comment", "arguments": {"doc_id": "doc-rollup-ownership-retro", "body": "Before the May 2023 audit, rollup-service was effectively unowned in practice: people each had part of the map, but nobody had the complete downstream ownership picture. The Apr 18 outage exposed that gap. The lesson was to name a single accountable owner and make the downstream boundary explicit; the audit assigned rollup-service to Cyrus\u2019s team. Keep this distinct from metric-rollup, the separate deprecated service."}, "field_being_checked": "result.comment.body"}

CRITERION:
The comment says rollup-service lacked practical ownership before the audit, leaving people with partial maps and nobody with the full downstream story. It does not make claims about the later owner map.

Return the JSON verdict now.

{"passed":false,"reason":"The comment correctly says rollup-service was effectively unowned and people had only partial maps, but it also makes a disallowed claim about the later owner map: “the audit assigned rollup-service to Cyrus’s team.”"}
